title: Ply Problem vs VAJRA Reveal

scenes.video_prompt: Vertical smartphone video on an Indian RCC slab construction site, handheld camera, natural sunlight. An Indian construction worker pries down a swollen, water-damaged brown wooden plywood shuttering sheet from the ceiling during de-shuttering. The brown wooden ply cracks and splinters in half, revealing frayed damp wood layers. No text, no logos, authentic construction site background.
